## Dress code

 Like many tech companies, we have a relaxed dress code. We do not require or expect traditional business
 attire of any sort. T-shirts, shorts, and athletic wear are frequently worn by our team members.

 With that said though, we expect all employees to dress in a way that’s not unprofessional, tacky, or
 excessively distracting. Please do not wear clothing that is revealing, falling apart, noticeably dirty, or
 unnecessarily disruptive.
